summary: The filing is an 8-K by Coya Therapeutics reporting first quarter 2026 financial results under Item 2.02 and disclosing under Item 8.01 that the FDA granted Fast Track Designation to COYA 302 for ALS. No special-situation transaction is involved; it is a routine earnings and operational update. The document includes management commentary on the ALSTARS trial and financial position but contains no offer, merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist activity, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. It is purely a periodic business update.
